scope: synthetic or dedicated non-production environments only

cases.fault: client loses the HTTP 202 response after durable acceptance
cases.expected: retry reuses eventId; inbox unique identity prevents a second accepted row
cases.verification: reconcile telemetry_inbox and ClickHouse by project_id,event_id

cases.fault: terminate worker after ClickHouse insert and before PostgreSQL completion
cases.expected: transactional state rolls back; retry completes; read-time FINAL hides physical duplicate
cases.verification: integration regression plus reconciliation physical-duplicate count

cases.fault: stop or isolate PostgreSQL during acceptance/worker processing
cases.expected: no false durability claim; client retains/retries; worker reports dependency error
cases.verification: metrics, logs, pending age, and recovery drain

cases.fault: make ClickHouse write fail after inbox acceptance
cases.expected: detector state and completion do not commit; bounded retry/dead-letter behavior applies
cases.verification: integration regression, dead-letter metadata, and recovery drain

cases.fault: make Redis unavailable for live publish/state
cases.expected: durable acceptance remains independent where configured; best-effort features degrade visibly
cases.verification: health gauges, metrics, and durable ledger

cases.fault: deliver a batch in a different order than event time
cases.expected: detectors sort by event time and deterministic event identity
cases.verification: detector tests and adversarial fuzz artifact

cases.fault: deliver an event older than the processed visitor watermark
cases.expected: retain for analytics without retroactive detection/state mutation
cases.verification: late-event integration test and inbox/ClickHouse reconciliation

cases.fault: reuse an explicit eventId with a changed payload
cases.expected: HTTP 409 and no accepted row for the conflicting payload

cases.fault: deliver the same provider message ID more than once
cases.expected: one inbound row and at most one local reply attempt
cases.verification: provider ID unique index and simulator messageId injection

cases.fault: cross-project query or payload contains secret/PII-shaped values
cases.expected: query remains tenant-scoped; persisted props are masked before storage
cases.verification: tenant isolation and masking regression tests
